notes: Tax rules are kept in this file, not in the code (FR-018). To update for a new year, copy this file and change the numbers. Sources: ATO resident tax rates 2025-26; ATO working from home fixed rate method (70c/hour for 2024-25 and 2025-26); Medicare levy low-income thresholds 2025-26 (singles).

medicareLevySurcharge.note: Used only to raise a flag asking for a private health insurance statement (FR-024). The surcharge itself is not calculated in this release.

depreciation.effectiveLifeNote: Effective lives follow the Capstone 1 use case (chair = 10 years). Confirm each value against ATO TR 2022/1 before relying on them.
